claire_sales: Customer wants air-gapped POC. They asked: how we deliver bundles, upgrade cadence, and who needs access.

omar_se: topology? single DC, no egress?

claire_sales: correct, no egress. transfer via courier disk or encrypted USB only.

janet_ops: we'll do: initial signed full bundle + two delta minibundles. Provide preflight verifier and install runbook. No online telemetry.

ross_sec: require SBOM and signed manifest. Prefer customer-owned root cert; otherwise we'll sign with HSM and provide audit logs. No persistent Redwood accounts.

omarse: pricing: POC PS 24h + ops packaging fee $3k. Prod: monthly delta management fee + per-bundle ops charge.

deploy-bot: build:2026-06-10 sha256:beefcafe sbom:attached

claire_sales: can we get a sample package and short exec summary by EOD tomorrow? I'll send to customer.

janet_ops: I'll assemble sample bundle + preflight script. ross_sec will write key mgmt wording.

ross_sec: blocker: if they insist on signing locally, schedule 2h cert exchange.

claire_sales: noted. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
